1879060327.name: Battle-shout
1879060327.desc: An attack that triggers a Battle-readied State, enabling you to deal more damage.

1879109223.name: Safeguard
1879109223.desc: A quick strike, which damages the enemy and heals you over time.

1879139047.name: Rabid Bite
1879139047.desc: Foaming at the mouth, you bite your opponent.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879157607.name: Invulnerability
1879157607.desc: A buff that greatly increases coloured armour for a short time.

1879198311.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Weathered-bear)
1879198311.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879228135.name: Spear and Fist
1879228135.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their spear and fist for attack.

1879232487.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Bear)
1879232487.desc: Your bond with the natural world allows you to call upon old friends long gone.

1879244007.name: Bandage
1879244007.desc: Bandages are primarily used in patching the arms of wounded soldiers.

1879271271.name: Champion's Duel
1879271271.desc: Duel the enemy, increasing your damage every few seconds.\n\nDebuffs the foe's damage and movement speed.

1879272167.name: Horse of the Midsummer
1879272167.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879273447.name: Horse of Plenty
1879273447.desc: A horse from the Farmers Faire.

1879274087.name: Snap Shot - Wages of Fear
1879274087.desc: Turning your back on a Warden with javelin at hand is likely to be the last thing you do.\n\nThis skill deals extra damage when used from behind.

1879302631.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Pilgrim)
1879302631.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879412839.name: Spooky Jackdaw
1879412839.desc: Summons a companion of the Autumn Sage.

1879428071.name: Mocking Taunt
1879428071.desc: Deliver some choice words to your opponent, dealing Light-type damage. Has a chance to restore morale.

1879449575.name: Greater Anthem II - War
1879449575.desc: Anthem: Increases Ranged and Tactical Damage of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 2 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879449831.name: Nature's Vengeance (Dual)
1879449831.desc: Your deep bond with Nature allows you to purge evil powers from even the darkest of hearts.

1879491559.name: Beacon of Hope
1879491559.desc: Transfers Morale to your allies and companions.

1879497703.name: Major Pet Command
1879497703.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506535.name: Devotion: Gelid Wind
1879506535.desc: Devoting yourself to the gelid wind, your ancient blood channels the gnawing cold plaguing Forochel to this day. With this power, you transform all your damaging skills into frost-based skills, and you gain access to other powers fuelled by fell frost.

1879506663.name: Insight of Iron
1879506663.desc: Empower your allies with your fell understanding, improving their defence.

1879521383.name: Copper Zizanu
1879521383.desc: Summons a helpful copper zizanu to accompany you on your travels.

1879528807.name: Prepare: Fire-spike
1879528807.desc: Sends a spike of fire at a target dealing damage and adding a small damage-over-time effect.
